semantic.prior: 64 symbols expose six binary attributes; four binary output attributes; linear neural heads
semantic.training: Read accepted current facts from neural matrices only; minimum 16 supplied-quality facts; no persisted answer table
semantic.split: 32 even-parity keys observed, 32 odd-parity combinations withheld; random four-attribute rule and complements per world
semantic.gate: All eligible current facts agree, minimum bit confidence 0.9; reject otherwise; known facts take precedence; stale hypotheses abstain
semantic.audit: 3 seeds x 2 new rules; held-out accuracy >=0.95; source exclusion, contradictory correction rejection, stale suppression, no mutation of episodic state

skill.environment: 2D bounded numeric reaching, five actions, step 0.2, reward minus squared next-distance minus 0.01 action cost
skill.prior: Relative displacement and its quadratic features supplied; linear action-value heads from random weights
skill.training: Uniform exploratory actions; update selected action prediction using observed outcome and scalar feedback; no target action labels
skill.split: Train excludes same-sign corners |dx|,|dy|>0.6; audit includes excluded corners and translated goals
skill.audit: 3 seeds; 512 unseen episodes, <=12 steps, success radius 0.16, success >=0.95; random/untrained/oracle controls

language_readiness: atomic optimizer/RNG checkpoint and exact CPU continuation
